about: Country cards for lives born in Bangladesh. Each card is dealt only to them (and a little more often than general cards). Sources are in each card's "src".

events.src: ===================== Bangladesh (BD) ===================== Microcredit: the Microcredit Regulatory Authority caps interest at 24% a year on a declining balance, since 2019 (The Business Standard; Financial Express). Business outcomes are game rules.

opts.do: cash += .3 * B; T('bd_micro', { kind: 'custom', label: M('trk.bd_micro'), v: .3 * B }); rec('bd_micro', .19 * B, 2); later(age + 1, 'sideBiz', { id: 'bd_shop', p: .55, a: .12 * B, n: 6 })
yearly('bdsave', { amt: .03 * B, until: age + 10 }, { rate: 0 }, 'trk.bdsave')

en..x: A microfinance NGO offers you a small loan to start a business, repaid in weekly instalments. Interest is capped at 24% a year by the Microcredit Regulatory Authority.
en..loan: Take the loan and open a small shop
en..loan.s: Get {a} now; repay about {b} a year for 2 years.
en..loan.h: About half of these small businesses bring in a steady extra income.
en..save.s: Save about {a} a year for 10 years.

zh..x: 一家小额信贷机构愿意借你一笔小钱做生意，每周分期还款。小额信贷监管局规定年利率最高24%。
zh..loan.s: 现在拿到{a}；每年还约{b}，还2年。
zh..loan.h: 这类小生意大约一半能带来稳定的额外收入。
zh..save: 改参加他们的储蓄计划

zht..x: 一家小額信貸機構願意借你一筆小錢做生意，每週分期還款。小額信貸監管局規定年利率最高24%。
zht..loan.s: 現在拿到{a}；每年還約{b}，還2年。
zht..loan.h: 這類小生意大約一半能帶來穩定的額外收入。
zht..save: 改參加他們的儲蓄計畫

events.src: The Gulf: remittances passed $30bn (FY2024–25, $30.33bn); a record 750,000+ workers went to Saudi Arabia in 2025 (Daily Star; Arab News). Migration costs, pay and housing multiples are ESTIMATES.

en..x: A recruiting agency offers a three-year job in Saudi Arabia at about {a} a year, with housing provided. A record 750,000 Bangladeshis went to work there in 2025, and remittances passed $30 billion in 2024–25. Migration costs are high and often borrowed.

zh..x: 一家中介给你一份去沙特的三年工作，年薪约{a}，包住宿。2025年有创纪录的75万孟加拉人去那里工作，2024–25年度侨汇超过300亿美元。出国费用很高，常常要借钱。

zht..x: 一家中介給你一份去沙烏地阿拉伯的三年工作，年薪約{a}，包住宿。2025年有創紀錄的75萬孟加拉人去那裡工作，2024–25年度僑匯超過300億美元。出國費用很高，常常要借錢。

events.src: Floods and cyclones: low-lying areas flood in most monsoon seasons and cyclones strike the coast (Bangladesh Meteorological Department). The chance that a flood or storm reaches you comes from EM-DAT (people affected a year, 2000–2024: js/data.js); premiums, damage and preparation costs are ESTIMATES.

en..x: Low-lying areas flood in most monsoon seasons, and cyclones strike the coast. Your home is close to a river.

zh..x: 低洼地区大多数季风季节都会淹水，沿海还会遭遇气旋。你家离河很近。

zht..x: 低窪地區大多數季風季節都會淹水，沿海還會遭遇氣旋。你家離河很近。

events.src: Sanchayapatra: the 5-year Bangladesh Savings Certificate pays up to 12.40% a year from Jan 2025, taxed 5–10% (UNB). With inflation near 9%, about 2% real: an ESTIMATE.

en..x: The five-year Bangladesh Sanchayapatra pays up to 12.4% a year (from January 2025), with 5–10% tax on the profit.
en..buy.s: Put {a} in. About 2% a year after inflation and tax.

zh..x: 五年期国民储蓄凭证（Sanchayapatra）年利率最高12.4%（2025年1月起），利息要缴5–10%的税。
zh..buy.s: 放入{a}。扣除通胀和税后每年约2%。

zht..x: 五年期國民儲蓄憑證（Sanchayapatra）年利率最高12.4%（2025年1月起），利息要繳5–10%的稅。
zht..buy.s: 放入{a}。扣除通膨和稅後每年約2%。

events.src: Universal Pension Scheme (from 17 Aug 2023): Surokkha for informal workers at Tk1,000–5,000 a month; Samata for low incomes at Tk1,000 with the government paying half (Daily Star; upension.gov.bd). Tk12,000 a year ≈ 0.11 of the game's typical wage. Real returns are an ESTIMATE.

opts.do: yearly('upen', { amt: .11 * B, until: 60 }, { rate: .02, lock: 60 }, 'trk.upen')
yearly('upen', { amt: .055 * B, until: 60, bonus: 1 }, { rate: .02, lock: 60 }, 'trk.upen')

en..x: Since August 2023, informal workers can join the Universal Pension Scheme: Surokkha takes Tk1,000–5,000 a month, and Samata, for low incomes, takes Tk1,000 a month with the government paying half.
en..samata.s: About {a} a year; the government adds {b}.

zh..x: 从2023年8月起，非正规就业者可以参加全民养老金计划：Surokkha每月交1,000到5,000塔卡；给低收入者的Samata每月交1,000塔卡，政府出一半。

zht..x: 從2023年8月起，非正規就業者可以參加全民退休金計畫：Surokkha每月交1,000到5,000塔卡；給低收入者的Samata每月交1,000塔卡，政府出一半。

events.src: Moving to Dhaka: pay and cost multiples are ESTIMATES.

en..x: A job in Dhaka pays about {a} a year, but rent is higher and you’d be far from your family.
en..go.s: Pay {a} a year. Costs about 25% higher. Happiness −1.

zh..x: 达卡的一份工作年薪约{a}，但房租较高，而且离家人很远。

zht..x: 達卡的一份工作年薪約{a}，但房租較高，而且離家人很遠。

events.src: Private tutoring for the SSC and HSC exams is widespread (education household surveys); fees and outcomes are ESTIMATES.

opts.do: T('bd_tuition', { kind: 'ghost', label: M('trk.tuition') }); rec('bd_tuition', .12 * B, 4); happy -= 1; kidWin(.3, .65)
T('bd_tuition', { kind: 'ghost', label: M('trk.tuition') }); rec('bd_tuition', .04 * B, 4); kidWin(.2, .75)

en..x: Your child’s SSC exams are coming. Private tutors and coaching centres are everywhere, and many families pay for several subjects.
en..much.s: About {a} a year for 4 years. Busy evenings: Happiness −1.
en..much.h: A better chance of a scholarship later.
en..some: A tutor for the hardest subjects
en..some.h: Some chance of a scholarship later.
en..none.h: A small chance of a scholarship later.

zh..x: 孩子的中学毕业考试（SSC）快到了。私人家教和补习中心到处都是，很多家庭会请好几科。
zh..much.s: 每年约{a}，共4年。晚上很忙：幸福感 −1。
zh..much.h: 以后拿奖学金的机会较大。
zh..some.h: 以后有一些机会拿奖学金。
zh..none.h: 以后拿奖学金的机会较小。

zht..x: 孩子的中學畢業考試（SSC）快到了。私人家教和補習中心到處都是，很多家庭會請好幾科。
zht..much.s: 每年約{a}，共4年。晚上很忙：幸福感 −1。
zht..much.h: 以後拿獎學金的機會較大。
zht..some.h: 以後有一些機會拿獎學金。
zht..none.h: 以後拿獎學金的機會較小。

events.src: Samity: a neighbourhood savings group with a rotating pot. Risk ESTIMATE.

en..x: Neighbours run a savings samity: members pay in every month, and each month the pot goes to one member, drawn by lot.

zh..x: 邻居们办了一个储蓄互助会（samity）：会员每月交钱，每月抽签由一人拿走会钱。

zht..x: 鄰居們辦了一個儲蓄互助會（samity）：會員每月交錢，每月抽籤由一人拿走會錢。

events.src: Mobile-money fraud: a common trick is a caller posing as a bKash agent or call centre who says money was sent to your number by mistake and asks for the code (OTP) just sent to your phone (The Financial Express reports on arrests of fraud gangs); bKash says it never asks for your PIN or OTP, and its helpline is 16247. Amounts are an ESTIMATE.

opts.do: pay(a); const t = T('bd_otp', {kind: 'ghost', label: M('trk.bd_otp')}); t.spent += a; t.g += a; happy -= 3

en..x: A man calls, very polite: he is from bKash, and Tk5,000 was sent to your account by mistake. To send it back, he needs the code that has just arrived on your phone.
en..give.s: He thanks you and hangs up.
en..give.h: The code lets him into your account: about {a} gone.
en..hang.h: bKash never asks for your PIN or code.

zh..x: 有个男人很客气地打电话来：他说他是bKash的人，有五千塔卡误转到你的账户。要退回去，他需要你手机刚收到的验证码。
zh..give.h: 验证码让他进了你的账户：大约{a}没了。
zh..hang.h: bKash从来不会要你的密码或验证码。

zht..x: 有個男人很客氣地打電話來：他說他是bKash的人，有五千塔卡誤轉到你的帳戶。要退回去，他需要你手機剛收到的驗證碼。
zht..give.h: 驗證碼讓他進了你的帳戶：大約{a}沒了。
zht..hang.h: bKash從來不會要你的密碼或驗證碼。

events.src: Garment work: the entry-level minimum wage is Tk12,500 a month from 1 December 2023, up from Tk8,000 in 2018; the Labour Act 2006 sets 8 hours a day and 48 a week, up to 10 hours a day with overtime, paid at twice the basic rate (Labour Act s.108, via MiHCM payroll guide). Pay and health effects are an ESTIMATE.

opts.do: spend('bd_course', .05 * base, 'trk.bd_course'); addSkill('learn', 2, M('trk.learn')); bump('bd_sup', 1.06, M('trk.bd_sup')); happy -= 1

en..x: Orders are pouring in for the new season. The line supervisor says anyone can stay two extra hours every night, at double the basic rate.
en..ot.s: Two more hours a day, paid double.
en..ot.h: Pay about 25% higher for four years; Health −1 a year, Happiness −1.
en..course: Take an evening course to become a supervisor
en..course.h: Skill +2, pay about 6% higher for good. Happiness −1 while you study.

zh..x: 新一季的订单涌进来。线长说谁都可以每天晚上多留两小时，按底薪的两倍算。
zh..ot.s: 每天多做两小时，算双倍。
zh..ot.h: 四年内收入大约高25%；健康每年 −1，幸福感 −1。
zh..course: 上夜间课程，准备当线长
zh..course.h: 技能 +2，薪水永久高大约6%。读书期间幸福感 −1。

zht..x: 新一季的訂單湧進來。線長說誰都可以每天晚上多留兩小時，按底薪的兩倍算。
zht..ot.s: 每天多做兩小時，算雙倍。
zht..ot.h: 四年內收入大約高25%；健康每年 −1，幸福感 −1。
zht..course: 上夜間課程，準備當線長
zht..course.h: 技能 +2，薪水永久高大約6%。讀書期間幸福感 −1。

events.src: Weak banks: in 2025 five troubled Shariah banks (First Security, Union, Global Islami, Social Islami and EXIM) were merged into the state-run Sammilito Islami Bank; deposits up to Tk2 lakh were repaid from the Deposit Insurance Fund, while larger depositors could take out Tk1 lakh every three months for up to two years (emergencies up to Tk10 lakh from July 2026) (The Daily Star; Dhaka Tribune; Ittefaq). Weak banks had offered higher rates to attract deposits. Tk2 lakh ≈ 1.8 of the game’s typical wage; rates and odds are an ESTIMATE.

en..x: You want to put your savings in a fixed deposit. A big bank offers a modest rate; a smaller bank down the road offers two points more.
en..big.h: About 1% a year above inflation, and safe.
en..weak: The bank with the higher rate
en..weak.h: Banks that pay much more are often in trouble.
en.trk.bd_big: Fixed deposit at a big bank
en.trk.bd_weak: Fixed deposit at a small bank

zh..x: 你想把存款拿去做定存。大银行的利率普通；街上一家小银行多给两个百分点。
zh..big.h: 扣除通胀后每年大约1%，很安全。
zh..weak.h: 利率特别高的银行常常有问题。

zht..x: 你想把存款拿去做定存。大銀行的利率普通；街上一家小銀行多給兩個百分點。
zht..big.h: 扣除通膨後每年大約1%，很安全。
zht..weak.h: 利率特別高的銀行常常有問題。

events.src: After the 2025 merger, deposits up to Tk2 lakh (≈ 1.8 of the game’s typical wage) were repaid from the Deposit Insurance Fund and larger ones were released in instalments over two years (Bangladesh Bank, via The Daily Star). The loss to inflation while money is held is an ESTIMATE.

opts.do: lots.bd_weak.v -= g; lots.bd_weak.tout += g; cash += g; happy -= 2

en..t: Your bank has been taken over
en..x: The central bank has merged your bank with four others. Your {a} is safe on paper, but withdrawals are rationed.
en..wait.h: Happiness −3; years without interest while prices rise.
en..take.h: Happiness −2; the rest stays in the queue.

zh..x: 央行把你的银行跟另外四家合并了。你的{a}在纸面上没事，但提款有限额。
zh..wait.h: 幸福感 −3；好几年没利息，物价却一直涨。
zh..take.h: 幸福感 −2；其余的继续排队。

zht..x: 央行把你的銀行跟另外四家合併了。你的{a}在紙面上沒事，但提款有限額。
zht..wait.h: 幸福感 −3；好幾年沒利息，物價卻一直漲。
zht..take.h: 幸福感 −2；其餘的繼續排隊。

events.src: Land sharing with developers: owners of small plots in Dhaka commonly give the land to a developer, who builds flats and hands the owner a share of them, often half (industry practice); projects are often delayed for years. Land in central Dhaka is worth crores of taka per katha (Prothom Alo). The rent from your share, the sale price and the odds of delays are an ESTIMATE; famSpent lowers what your parents leave you.

later.bd_flats: const t = T('bd_flats', {kind: 'custom', label: M('trk.bd_flats')}); rec('bd_flats', -.15 * base, 30); log(M('log.bd_flats'), 'good')

en..x: Your parents still own the small plot with the old tin-roofed house in Dhaka. A developer offers to build a six-storey block on it and give the family half the flats.
en..jv.s: Flats in a few years; the family moves out meanwhile.
en..jv.h: Rent from your share of the flats for decades, if the developer finishes on time.
en..sell: Sell the plot and share the money
en..sell.h: Money now, but it comes out of what your parents would leave you.
en..wait.s: Your parents stay in their house.
en.log.bd_flats: The developer hands over the family’s flats. Tenants move into yours.

zh..x: 爸妈在达卡还有一小块地，上面是铁皮屋顶的老房子。一个开发商提议在那里盖六层楼，盖好后分一半的公寓给你们家。
zh..jv.s: 几年后拿到公寓；这段时间全家要先搬走。
zh..jv.h: 开发商如期完工的话，你那份公寓能收几十年的租金。
zh..sell.h: 现在拿到钱，但会从父母留给你的遗产里扣。
zh.log.bd_flats: 开发商交了公寓给你们家。你那几间租出去了。

zht..x: 爸媽在達卡還有一小塊地，上面是鐵皮屋頂的老房子。一個建商提議在那裡蓋六層樓，蓋好後分一半的公寓給你們家。
zht..jv.s: 幾年後拿到公寓；這段時間全家要先搬走。
zht..jv.h: 建商如期完工的話，你那份公寓能收幾十年的租金。
zht..sell.h: 現在拿到錢，但會從父母留給你的遺產裡扣。
zht.log.bd_flats: 建商交了公寓給你們家。你那幾間租出去了。

events.src: Developer projects in Dhaka are often stalled by funding gaps or disputes, and owners go to court or to the developers’ association, REHAB (news reports). Costs are an ESTIMATE.

en..x: Two floors are up, then nothing. The developer says he is waiting for a bank loan.
en..court.h: Pressure helps a little; the flats still come late.

zh..x: 盖了两层就停了。开发商说他在等银行贷款。
zh..wait.s: 这段时间家人在别处租房。
zh..court.h: 施压有一点用；公寓还是会晚交。

zht..x: 蓋了兩層就停了。建商說他在等銀行貸款。
zht..wait.s: 這段時間家人在別處租房。
zht..court.h: 施壓有一點用；公寓還是會晚交。

events.src: Eid-ul-Azha: about 9.14 million animals were sacrificed in Bangladesh in 2025, 4.7 million of them cattle and buffaloes (Department of Livestock Services, via Dhaka Tribune, Jun 2025); a cow may be shared by up to seven families, and much of the meat is given away. A cow (≈ Tk1 lakh ≈ 0.9 of the game’s typical wage) and a share are an ESTIMATE.

en..x: The cattle markets are full before Eid. Your neighbours ask whether your family will take a whole cow this year, or a share with them.
en..cow.s: About {a}; meat for the family, relatives and the poor.
en..share: A seventh share with the neighbours

zh..x: 宰牲节前牛市挤满了人。邻居问你家今年要买整头牛，还是跟他们合买一份。
zh..cow.s: 大约{a}；肉分给家人、亲戚和穷人。

zht..x: 宰牲節前牛市擠滿了人。鄰居問你家今年要買整頭牛，還是跟他們合買一份。
zht..cow.s: 大約{a}；肉分給家人、親戚和窮人。

events.src: Treatment abroad: India issued over 2 million visas to Bangladeshis in 2023, most for medical care, but after August 2024 fewer than 1,000 medical visas a working day, down from 5,000–7,000 (Reuters, via Al Jazeera, Jan 2025); Thailand costs far more. Government hospitals are cheap but crowded. Costs are an ESTIMATE.

en..x: Your parent needs heart surgery. Before 2024 many families went to India, but medical visas have become hard to get.
en..govt.s: Cheap, with a long wait and crowded wards.
en..govt.h: Happiness −2 from the worry and the queues.
en..abroad.h: Excellent care, at several times the price.

zh..x: 你的父亲或母亲需要做心脏手术。2024年以前很多人去印度看病，现在医疗签证很难拿了。
zh..govt.s: 便宜，但要等很久，病房很挤。
zh..abroad.h: 照顾很好，但价钱是好几倍。

zht..x: 你的父親或母親需要做心臟手術。2024年以前很多人去印度看病，現在醫療簽證很難拿了。
zht..govt.s: 便宜，但要等很久，病房很擠。
zht..abroad.h: 照顧很好，但價錢是好幾倍。

events.src: Remittances: the government adds a 2.5% cash incentive to money sent through banks and licensed channels (2% from 2019, 2.5% from 2022), while informal hundi dealers often offer a better rate but no protection (TBS; The Daily Star: a record $32.8bn came through official channels in 2025). The rate gap and the risk of losing a transfer are an ESTIMATE.

opts.do: T('bd_inc', {kind: 'custom', label: M('trk.bd_hundi')}); rec('bd_inc', -.02 * base, 3); if (roll('bd_hundi') < .15) later(age + 1, 'bd_hundiLost', {})

en..x: Every month you send money to your family. A man at the market offers a better rate than the bank, through hundi.
en..bank.s: The official rate, plus a 2.5% government incentive.
en..bank.h: Safe, and the incentive adds up.
en..hundi.s: A better rate, cash delivered to your family.
en..hundi.h: A little more each month, but it is illegal and dealers sometimes vanish with the money.
en.log.bd_hundiLost: The hundi dealer disappeared with your family’s money: {a} lost.

zh..x: 你每个月都寄钱回家。市场里有个人说走“hundi”地下汇兑，汇率比银行好。
zh..hundi.s: 汇率较好，现金直接送到家人手上。
zh..hundi.h: 每个月多一点，但这是违法的，偶尔有人卷款跑路。
zh.log.bd_hundiLost: hundi的人带着你家人的钱跑了：损失{a}。

zht..x: 你每個月都寄錢回家。市場裡有個人說走「hundi」地下匯兌，匯率比銀行好。
zht..hundi.s: 匯率較好，現金直接送到家人手上。
zht..hundi.h: 每個月多一點，但這是違法的，偶爾有人捲款跑路。
zht.log.bd_hundiLost: hundi的人帶著你家人的錢跑了：損失{a}。

events.src: BCS exam: about 338,000 people applied for 3,140 posts in the 46th BCS (advertised in 2023), and 374,747 for 3,688 posts in the 47th (advertised in 2024) (Prothom Alo; UNB), about one in a hundred; many quit work to prepare full-time. The chance for a serious candidate (3%), the year of lost pay and the pay and pension effects are an ESTIMATE.

later.bd_bcs: if (roll('bd_bcs') < .03) { bump('bd_bcs', .95, M('trk.bd_bcs')); layM = (layM || 1) * .1; penM = (penM || 1) * 1.3; happy += 6; log(M('log.bd_bcsOk'), 'good') } else { log(M('log.bd_bcsNo'), 'bad'); happy -= 2 }

en..x: Your friends from university are leaving their jobs to prepare full-time for the BCS civil-service exam. A cadre post is the job every family dreams of.
en..try: Quit and prepare for a year
en..try.s: Coaching fees, and a year with almost no pay.
en..try.h: Happiness −2. About one applicant in a hundred gets a post; those who do have a job for life and a better pension.
en.trk.bd_bcsP: A year preparing for the BCS
en.log.bd_bcsOk: You passed the BCS and join the civil service. The whole family celebrates.
en.log.bd_bcsNo: You didn’t make the BCS list, and go back to private work.

zh..x: 大学同学纷纷辞职，全心准备BCS公务员考试。当上公务员是每个家庭的梦想。
zh..try.s: 补习费，还有一年几乎没收入。
zh..try.h: 幸福感 −2。大约一百个人只有一个考上；考上的人一辈子有工作，退休金也比较好。
zh.log.bd_bcsOk: 你考上BCS，进了公务员体系。全家都在庆祝。
zh.log.bd_bcsNo: 你没考上BCS，回到私人企业工作。

zht..x: 大學同學紛紛辭職，全心準備BCS公務員考試。當上公務員是每個家庭的夢想。
zht..try.s: 補習費，還有一年幾乎沒收入。
zht..try.h: 幸福感 −2。大約一百個人只有一個考上；考上的人一輩子有工作，退休金也比較好。
zht.log.bd_bcsOk: 你考上BCS，進了公務員體系。全家都在慶祝。
zht.log.bd_bcsNo: 你沒考上BCS，回到私人企業工作。

events.src: University: public universities charge low fees but entry is very competitive and sessions are often delayed; top private universities charge by the credit, e.g. Tk8,000 a credit for the BBA at North South University (NSU fee page, 2026), about Tk10–11 lakh for a degree with fees (≈ 9.5 of the game’s typical wage). Pay effects are an ESTIMATE.

en..x: You have a place at a public university outside Dhaka. Your parents could also pay for a private university in the city.
en..public.h: Happiness −1: crowded halls, and sessions often run late.
en..private.s: About {a} in all, paid by your parents.
en..private.h: Happiness +2, pay about 3% higher; it comes out of what they would leave you.

zh..x: 你考上了达卡以外的一所公立大学。爸妈也负担得起城里的私立大学。
zh..public.h: 幸福感 −1：宿舍拥挤，学期常常延误。
zh..private.h: 幸福感 +2，薪水大约高3%；这笔钱会从他们留给你的遗产里扣。

zht..x: 你考上了達卡以外的一所公立大學。爸媽也負擔得起城裡的私立大學。
zht..public.h: 幸福感 −1：宿舍擁擠，學期常常延誤。
zht..private.h: 幸福感 +2，薪水大約高3%；這筆錢會從他們留給你的遺產裡扣。

events.src: Arsenic: in 2019, 11.8% of people (17.5 million) drank water above Bangladesh’s arsenic limit of 50 ppb, five times the WHO guideline (MICS 2019, BBS/UNICEF), and 9.9% of households in MICS 2025. Wells can be tested; long exposure causes skin lesions, cancers and heart disease. The chance your well is unsafe (12%), filter costs and health effects are an ESTIMATE.

opts.do: spend('bd_test', .01 * base, 'trk.bd_test'); if (roll('bd_arsenic') < .12) { T('bd_filter', {kind: 'custom', label: M('trk.bd_filter')}); rec('bd_filter', .02 * base, 20) }

en..x: A health worker is testing tube wells in your area for arsenic. Your family has drunk from yours for years.
en..test.h: If it is unsafe, a filter or another well keeps your family healthy.
en..skip.h: About one well in eight is unsafe, and the harm builds up over the years.

zh..x: 卫生人员在你们这一带检测压水井的砷含量。你家喝这口井的水已经好多年了。
zh..test.h: 如果水不安全，装滤水器或改用别的井就能保护家人健康。
zh..skip.h: 大约八口井就有一口不安全，伤害会年复一年累积。

zht..x: 衛生人員在你們這一帶檢測壓水井的砷含量。你家喝這口井的水已經好多年了。
zht..test.h: 如果水不安全，裝濾水器或改用別的井就能保護家人健康。
zht..skip.h: 大約八口井就有一口不安全，傷害會年復一年累積。
